stickers.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: a single photographic pet sticker for a tiny memory matching game card. Edit target: the attached photo. Primary request: extract the funny close-up dog snout being gently squeezed, preserve its enormous nose, ears, eyes and the supporting hand, remove the garden and floor. Keep the pet's true photographic identity, fur markings, face proportions and pose exactly recognizable. Not a cartoon, no redrawing, no beauty retouch. Center one cleanly cropped subject with a bold smooth white die-cut outline around its silhouette, compact readable composition, generous transparent margin. Actual transparent background outside the white silhouette. No text, hearts, other animals, decorative elements, watermark or rectangular photo frame. Output one sticker only.
